rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone cannot tolerate waiting or delays.

example.english: I've been waiting half an hour; I'm really impatient.
example.traditional: 我等咗半個鐘，真係唔耐煩喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 zan1 hai6 m4 noi6 faan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the irritable or short-tempered side of impatience, especially when someone is restless.

example.english: They get impatient whenever they hit traffic.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sak1 ce1 zau6 hou2 cou3 dai2

rows.note: Use this when someone is anxious or eager to start or get something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gap1 soeng2 faai3 di1 hoi1 ci2
